action_language.starting_state: Each word begins in a fresh process at P0, executes frozen calibration ACTION6, verifies exact P1/RUNNING, then begins the scored word from the candidate's internal P1 state.
action_language.ordering: Lexicographic Cartesian order over ACTION6 then ACTION7 at lengths 1, 2, and 3.

screening.hardened_static: Reapply the AST contract and reject dangerous names and NumPy/file serialization attributes without importing source.
screening.calibration: Run empty post-P1 word once under PYTHONHASHSEED=0 for exact P0 replay and exact ACTION6 P1/RUNNING calibration.
screening.provisional: Run all 14 post-P1 words once under PYTHONHASHSEED=0; retain the first candidate in frozen id order for each complete trace signature.
screening.full_determinism: For every provisional unique candidate and word, run two repetitions under PYTHONHASHSEED 0, 1, 5, and 10; all projected traces must be byte-identical and successful.
screening.success: At least two exact-calibration, deterministic, behaviorally non-equivalent revised candidates; two is sufficient.

runtime_isolation.container: Unprivileged UID/GID 65532, read-only root, no network, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, bounded CPU/memory/PIDs/timeout, isolated noexec tmpfs.
runtime_isolation.mounts: Candidate and calibration mounts are read-only; calibration contains P0 and opened settled P1 only.
runtime_isolation.candidate_runtime_calls: No ARC, model, OIA, browser, API, hosted service, archive, or step-2 access from candidate processes.

adapter_and_oia.adapter: Complete deterministic bounded prefix-tree Mealy compilation over exact post-P1 traces.
adapter_and_oia.selected_next_action: Root action of the verified exact minimum-worst-case adaptive policy.

future_step2_baseline.name: P1 persistence
future_step2_baseline.prediction: Exact settled P1 frame and RUNNING status after the selected next action.

claim_boundary: Opened Track A intervention-triggered revision, exact calibration, bounded behavior admission, and OIA next-action selection only. Calibration is not prediction; no step-2 outcome, real ARC action, decision-value, private/sealed transfer, or Track B claim.
